text:
sara: Quick thread — MediWorks is ready to sign but procurement shipped a PO with net45 and says tax-exempt. They also insisted on BYO-KMS (HSM) and an EU data residency addendum. Can legal/security accept PO + esign path or do we need countersign/corp finance?
eli_legal: Can you attach the PO and the redlined MSA/DPA? Need to check if BYO-KMS language is acceptable and whether net45 requires finance OK.
sara: Attaching excerpt from order form: ```
Customer PO: 45321
Payment terms: Net45
Tax status: Exempt (certificate to be provided)
Keying: Customer-managed HSM (BYO-KMS) with key wrap and attestation
Notes: EU data residency requirement (Germany)
```
jordan_se: For the POC they set us up on hosted infra but asked for a Dedicated plan after POC. They want model pinned v1.2 and throughput guarantee in the order. POC traffic low but they want a path to Dedicated.
meera_sec: BYO-KMS: we can support external key management in Private/Dedicated setups, but for Hosted we only support Redwood-managed KMS. If they insist on BYO-KMS for POC (hosted) that's a blocker. We need HSM attestation docs and an ingress egress encryption checklist.
eli_legal: Ok. Two things: 1) For net45 we usually require finance approval for new customers — @finance please weigh in. 2) BYO-KMS needs a new addendum to the MSA that describes responsibilities and liabilities; we can propose standard "Customer-managed keys" clause, fallback to Redwood-managed keys if unsupported.
finance: We can approve Net45 for enterprise deals with credit review. Need signed order + contact for invoicing and a W9 / tax-exempt certificate. If customer is outside US (DE), provide EU tax docs.
sara: They already provided a PO contact (anna@mediworks.de). I'll ask for the tax cert and set up credit review. Any quick language we can send for the BYO-KMS fallback?
eli_legal: Draft suggestion: "Customer may elect to provide and manage encryption keys for Dedicated or Private deployments; for Hosted deployments, Redwood will provide RMK by default. Where BYO-KMS is used, customer must provide HSM attestation and indemnify Redwood against key compromise attributable to customer key management." I'll push a 1-page addendum and route to customer.
meera_sec: Addendum should require: HSM FIPS/SOC attestations, key rotation policy, and access control matrix. Also clarify logs and key escrow (no access by Redwood).
jordan_se: Customer happy to sign addendum, but they want e-sign. Can we route to DocuSign with countersign by Redwood legal only? They prefer a single-sign path (their PO + our order form) to speed POC start.
docusign-bot: Envelope created for Order Form + BYO-KMS addendum. Sent to anna@mediworks.de and eli_legal for signature.
eli_legal: I can countersign once finance confirms Net45. If we need an exec signature ( > $200k ), i'll escalate to ops leader.
tom_ops: If they move to Dedicated, we need a brief SOW on capacity and expected RPS. Also note EU residency requires deploying into the Frankfurt region; that'll add provisioning lead time ~7 business days.
sara: Thanks — I'll request the tax docs, ask customer to sign the DS envelope, and pause Hosted BYO-KMS requests until we confirm Dedicated path. I'll post updates here. :thumbsup:
eli_legal: Sounds good. Please add the PO and any redlines to the DocuSign envelope so finance can approve.
meera_sec: FYI — if customer insists on BYO-KMS for Hosted during POC, escalate to me and infra for a one-off security review. Might require Private deployment which is a longer lead time.
sara: Noted. Closing loop after they return tax cert and sign. Will ping if finance blocks.
